description: Core permissions for the main window. core:default grants read-only window getters only, so every mutation the chrome performs — dragging, resizing, the caption buttons — has to be listed explicitly. Note what is deliberately NOT here: core:window:allow-set-effects. The 外观 glass toggle no longer touches the OS backdrop at all (it is applied once at window creation and never removed; the toggle is pure CSS), because DWM will not recompose a visible window's frame when DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE changes and the effect only appeared after a minimise/restore. Put this permission back if that ever returns to being an IPC call — see gui/src/lib/glass.svelte.js.
